objects.name: Microsoft Edge security advisory (AV26-659)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-659 Date: July 6, 2026 On July 2, 2026, Microsoft published a security update to address vulnerabilities in the following product: Microsoft Edge Stable Channel – versions prior to 150.0.4078.48 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary update. Microsoft Edge Stable Channel Release Notes
